title: Explore your analytics with the Mintlify agent
summary: The Mintlify agent can now answer analytics questions about your docs, so you can understand user and agent trends without leaving the editor.
body_markdown:
The[Mintlify agent](https://www.mintlify.com/docs/agent) can now answer analytics questions about your docs. Now you can get a deeper understanding of both your user and agent trends and surface new insights.


## Ask the agent about analytics


Dashboards show you what changed, but they rarely explain why. With the agent, you can easily request specific breakdowns, compare page metrics, and investigate changes in traffic. This helps you understand how people and AI agents use your docs and where you can improve them.


## Get started


Open the Mintlify editor, and click **Ask agent** . From the agent panel, ask any question about your docs analytics. For example:


- *What are the top 5 user agents hitting my site?*
- *Which pages do agents visit far more than humans?*
- *What are people searching for and finding nothing?*
- *What was the trend of the REST API introduction page over the last month?*


For more examples and details, see[Ask about your analytics](https://www.mintlify.com/docs/editor/agent#ask-about-your-analytics) .
